name: TrueNAS Storage Destination
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Back up containers to a TrueNAS instance via WebDAV (RFC 4918). TrueNAS exposes WebDAV on the share's configured path (default `/webdav` for the standard WebDAV share). Operators authenticate with a local TrueNAS user + password over HTTP Basic auth. Chunked uploads use Content-Range PUT; the TrueNAS Samba server is built on samba.org which supports Content-Range PUT in WebDAV. Same Test round-trip shape (write / change / delete) as the SharePoint, Google Drive, and Nextcloud plugins.
